'''Syrh Rhoams''' was a passing admirer of the [[Music/Legends|singer]] [[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]].<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Rystáll Sant/Legends|Rystáll Sant]] is depicted wearing the [[Cape/Legends|cape]] during the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Rhoams had gifted her with a [[Cape/Legends|cape]].<ref name="SWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Syrh Rhoams was mentioned in the [[2011]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', which was written by [[Simon Beecroft]].<ref name="SWCE" />
